title: RED: Magic item importer coverage
description: Objective: Add failing tests for SRD 5.1 Magic Items A-Z parsing, emitting, section anchoring, and committed-pack baselines. Files: create packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseMagicItems.test.ts; modify packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/emit.test.ts, packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sections.test.ts, packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts as needed. Steps: write tests for Adamantine Armor, Ammunition +1/+2/+3, Amulet of Health, wrapped names/category lines, attunement parsing, embedded table text retention, magic-item record emission, lookup kind validation, and generated-pack baseline updates. Run focused tests and record the expected failures before production edits.
acceptance_criteria: Focused tests fail for missing parseMagicItems module, missing magic-item kind, missing emitter branch, or stale committed-pack baseline; failures are recorded on loreweaver-ecr.
close_reason: RED tests added and observed failing for expected missing magic-item importer behavior.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: RED verification: npx vitest run parseMagicItems.test.ts emit.test.ts sections.test.ts srdGeneratedPack.test.ts tools.test.ts -> failed as expected: missing parseMagicItems module, missing magicItems anchor, missing magicItemExtractionsToRecords/buildPack branch, lookup enum lacks magic-item, committed pack lacks magic-item spot keys.
